/* SQL ID : DscsEzGraderDAO.listDscsJoinUser 설명 : EZ-Grader 개인 토론 참여자 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.USER_ID AS stdId , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , NVL(A.SCR, 0) AS scr , A.EVLYN AS evlyn , NVL(A.DEPTNM, '-') AS deptNm , A.USERNM AS userNm , CASE WHEN A.ATCL_CNT > 0 THEN 'JOIN' ELSE 'NOTJOIN' END AS joinStatus FROM ( SELECT /*A.STD_ID, */ A.USER_ID , D.STDNT_NO , B.SCR , B.EVLYN , NVL((SELECT EE.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT EE WHERE EE.DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID), '-') AS DEPTNM , D.USERNM , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL AA WHERE AA.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} AND AA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND AA.DELYN = 'N' ) ATCL_CNT , 0 AS AFTER_ATCL_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT AA JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL AB ON AA.DSCS_ATCL_ID = AB.DSCS_ATCL_ID WHERE AB.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} AND AA.USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND AA.DELYN = 'N' ) CMNT_CNT FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID AND B.DELYN = 'N' AND B.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} JOIN TB_LMS_USER D ON A.USER_ID = D.USER_ID WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' ) A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.ATCL_CNT > 0
AND A.ATCL_CNT = 0
ORDER BY NVL(A.STDNT_NO, A.USER_ID), A.USER_ID
ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.ATCL_CNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, NVL(A.STDNT_NO, A.USER_ID), A.USER_ID
ORDER BY A.USERNM

/* SQL ID : DscsEzGraderDAO.listDscsJoinTeam 설명 : EZ-Grader 팀 토론 참여자 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.TEAM_TYCD , A.TEAM_ID , A.TEAMNM , A.DSCS_ID AS DSCS_ID , #{sbjctId} AS SBJCT_ID , A.USER_ID AS stdId , A.LDRYN AS leaderYn , NVL(A.SCR, 0) AS scr , A.EVLYN AS evlyn , A.USER_ID AS userId , A.STDNT_NO AS stdntNo , NVL(A.DEPTNM, '-') AS deptNm , A.USERNM AS userNm , CASE WHEN A.ATCL_CNT > 0 THEN 'JOIN' ELSE 'NOTJOIN' END AS joinStatus FROM ( SELECT A.TEAM_TYCD , B.TEAM_ID , B.TEAMNM , H.DSCS_ID -- , C.STD_ID , C.LDRYN , G.SCR , G.EVLYN , D.USER_ID , E.STDNT_NO /*, E.DEPTNM */ , NVL((SELECT EE.DEPTNM FROM TB_LMS_DEPT EE WHERE EE.DEPT_ID = E.DEPT_ID), '-') AS DEPTNM , E.USERNM /*, F.USER_ID*/ /* 중복 필드 */ , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL AA WHERE AA.DSCS_ID = H.DSCS_ID AND AA.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND AA.DELYN = 'N' ) ATCL_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT AA JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL AB ON AA.DSCS_ATCL_ID = AB.DSCS_ATCL_ID WHERE AB.DSCS_ID = H.DSCS_ID AND AA.USER_ID = C.USER_ID AND AA.DELYN = 'N' ) CMNT_CNT
, 0 AS AFTER_CMNT_CNT FROM TB_LMS_TEAM A JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM B ON A.TEAM_TYCD = B.TEAM_TYCD AND A.TEAM_ID = B.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS H ON A.TEAM_ID = H.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR C ON B.TEAM_ID = C.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC D ON C.USER_ID = D.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER E ON D.USER_ID = E.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_PTCP G ON C.USER_ID = G.USER_ID AND G.DELYN = 'N' AND G.DSCS_ID = H.DSCS_ID WHERE H.DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} ) A WHERE 1 = 1 /* TODO : 26.3.25:Tobe 사용안함.-제거 필요 */ /*
AND (A.AFTER_ATCL_CNT > 0 OR A.AFTER_CMNT_CNT > 0)
*/
ORDER BY LENGTH(A.TEAMNM), A.TEAMNM, NVL(A.STDNT_NO, A.USER_ID), A.USER_ID
ORDER BY LENGTH(A.TEAMNM), A.TEAMNM, CASE WHEN A.ATCL_CNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, A.USERNM
ORDER BY LENGTH(A.TEAMNM), A.TEAMNM, A.USERNM
